lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular nodes are visible posterior to the gill slits. The central column features four primary blobs with roughly equidistant vertical spacing, while the posterior column shows three visible nodes aligned with the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like structural pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a distinct shadow-cast lower boundary extending from the branchial region to the posterior field.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills displays a transition from the structured grid of the flank to a dense, stochastic arrangement of significantly smaller high-luminance points.
